_comment: Minimal trip detail response for AIRPORT TRANSFER trips (airport_pickup OR airport_drop). Only fields consumed by the frontend detail view are included. Fields omitted vs local: package (not applicable), rate_per_min (fixed fare, not per-minute), overages (airport is fixed fare). Fields added vs local: flight_number, terminal_number (pickup only; null for drop), toll_road_preferred, placard_required, placard_name, luggage counts (num_large_suitcases, num_carryons, num_backpacks, num_other_bags — shown in luggage summary component).
